name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: Existence(door_open) repeats what Existence(at_goal) with Precedence(door_open, at_goal) already forces. Remove Existence(door_open); keep the order and goal clauses.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) only requires the door to be open before the goal; it does not require opening the door. The task commands opening the door, so add a hard Existence(door_open). Keep Existence(at_goal), which with Precedence also forces door_open, and keep ExistenceTwo(has_key).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires holding the key on at least two different moves, but hard ExistenceTwo(has_key) is not achievable here. `has_key` is a persistent condition: once acquired, it stays true unless dropped. After the door is open, dropping the key does not make `key_lost` true, so the agent can drop and pick up the key again and satisfy ExistenceTwo. But the task only asks to be holding the key on two moves, which acquiring it once already ensures across multiple steps. Replace ExistenceTwo(has_key) with hard Existence(has_key); keep the hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) and Existence(at_goal).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the door to be opened, but no clause makes `door_open` happen. `Precedence(door_open, at_goal)` only forbids reaching the goal before the door has opened; it does not require opening the door. Add a hard `Existence(door_open)`.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) only requires the door to be open before the goal; it does not require the agent to open it. The task commands opening the door, so add a hard Existence(door_open).

NO CHANGES NEEDED: ExistenceTwo(has_key) requires holding the key on two different moves. Precedence(door_open, at_goal) puts the door opening before the goal, and Existence(at_goal) requires reaching it. The clauses capture the task without redundant existence clauses.

texts: The agent must hold the key on at least two different moves.
The door must be open before the agent reaches the goal.
The agent must reach the goal.
